content: Pojanjiana Aulataʼala tee Nuh
Kasiimpomo Aulataʼala abarakati Nuh tee manga anana tee afirimani i manga incia, "Koana-anamo koopu-opuamo tee ahandamo kabharina tee pabukemea alamu.

Namisi kaeka tee rengku i ingkomiu bheakangkanai sagala binata i alamu, sagala manu-manu i antara, sagala mopondelena i tana, tee sagala ikane i tawo. Bhari-bharia sumai kupasaraakaakea i nuncana limamu.
Sagala mokomingkuna, siitumo modhadhina, bheamembali kinandemiu. Bhari-bharia sumai kudhawuaka to ingkomiu, pokana giuna mboomo manga penembula maijo.
Maka bholi ukande o dagi mokoraa, roonamo inyawana sumai dhaangia i nuncana raa.

Iaku tantumo bhekutuntu kabholosi to raamu, siitumo inyawamu. Iaku bhekutuntu kabholosi minaaka i bhari-bharia binata, tee uka maanusia. Iaku bhekutuntu kabholosi to inyawana maanusia minaaka i limana samaanusiana.
Maka ingkomiu, koana-anamo koopu-opuamo tee ahandamo kabharina. Pabukemea alamu tee ahandamo kabharina i bhawona alamu sii."
Kasiimpomo Aulataʼala afirimanimo pendua i Nuh tee i manga anana mopobhawana tee incia,
"Satotuuna, Iaku kupatotapuaka pojanjiaku tee ingkomiu tee siwulumiu naile itu,

tee sagala mahaluku mokoinyawa mopobhawana tee ingkomiu, manu-manu, kadhambaaka tee sagala binata maila modhaangiana mopobhawana tee ingkomiu, bhari-bharia molimbana minaaka i bhangka maoge, siitumo sagala binata i alamu.
Iaku kupatotapuaka pojanjiaku tee ingkomiu: Indamo bheapendua uka sagala mahaluku apabinasea o uwena mawa, tee indamo bheapendua uka dhaangia uwena mawa to apabinasa alamu."

Aulataʼala uka afirimani, "Siimo tandana pojanjiaku ipadhaangiaku i tanga-tangana Iaku tee ingkomiu tee sagala mahaluku modhadhina mopobhawana tee ingkomiu, saangu pojanjia to bhari-bharia siwulumiu torotorosu saʼumurua:
Ntorouweku kudhikaia i taʼina ngalu, tee siitumo bheamembali tandana pojanjiana i tanga-tangana Iaku tee alamu.
Ande Iaku kuumbaaka taʼina ngalu i bhawona alamu tee ntorouwe sumai atokamata i manga taʼina ngalu,
Iaku bhekuudhani
pojanjiaku modhaangiana i tanga-tangana Iaku tee ingkomiu tee sagala mahaluku modhadhina, sagala mokoinyawana. Indamo bheapendua uwe amembali uwena mawa to apabinasa sagala mahaluku.

Ande ntorouwe sumai dhaangia i taʼina ngalu, siitumo Iaku bhekukamatea tee kuudhani pojanjiaku saʼumurua i tanga-tangana Aulataʼala tee sagala mokoinyawana, siitumo sagala mahaluku modhaangiana i alamu."
Kasiimpomo Aulataʼala afirimanimo i Nuh, "Siimo tandana pojanjiaku mopadhana ipatotapuakaku i tanga-tangana Iaku tee sagala mahaluku modhaangiana i alamu."
Nabii Nuh tee Manga Anana
Manga anana Nuh molimbana minaaka i bhangka maoge sarona Sem, Ham, tee Yafet. Ham satotuuna o amana Kanaan.
Talu miana sii siitumo manga anana Nuh, tee minaaka i manga incia sii amantalemo raʼeatina bhari-bharia alamu.
Nuh amembali pande poinawu tee inciamo mobhaa-bhaana mokarajaana inawuna angguru.
Saangu wakutuu sapadhana Incia asumpu angguru, amalangomo incia tee apotidhole akalealea i nuncana kemana.
Ham, o amana Kanaan, akamata auratina amana, kasiimpomo apetulatulaakea i rua mia witinaina i sambali.

Kasiimpomo Sem tee Yafet aalamo satuwu kae kasiimpo apasampea i awaana manga rua miaia. Sapadhana incia sumai, manga incia asowo i talikuna tee atutubhi auratina amana manga. Rouna manga abhalilia saweta mamudhaakana inda akamata auratina amana manga.
Wakutuu Nuh aepemo minaaka i kalangona angguru tee amataua opea mopadhana ipewauna anana kaepuna i incia,
apogaumo incia,

content.text: Bholiakamo incia amembali bhatua minaaka i tanga-tangana manga bhatua to manga witinaina."

content: Pogauna uka,

content.text: "Sagala puji to KAWASANA OPU, Aulataʼalana Sem!
Bholiakamo incia amboore i nuncana manga kemana Sem tee bholiakamo Kanaan amembali bhatuana."

content: Nuh dhaangiapo adhadhi 350 tao sapadhana uwena mawa sumai.
Sumaimo, Nuh akawa umuruna 950 tao, kasiimpomo incia amate.

footnotes.text: kuudhani: Maʼanana Aulataʼala amaheruakea giu incia sumai.

Kutundakomo Kanaan: Nabii Nuh akilalea tuaapa kadhakina akalana Kanaan tee manga siwuluna bhemomembalina naile naipua. Kamata Im. 18:3-28, iwe sumai atogambara tuaapa kadhakina pemingkuina manga miana Kanaan.
Yafet: Sarona Yafet aposiingi tee pogau Ibrani akomaʼana "apekalalesaia."
